summary: WhatsApp gaps from Workshop ewatrade/assistant/conversations, family 16b scenes x-link-expired, x-link-uncertain and x-link-edited (disposable web review links). The link message is now three lines: a draft-ready line naming the business and Store, the Review draft link, and "Expires in 15 minutes. Nothing is saved until you approve it." Replies about a sent review link are now answered deterministically before the model: "New link" issues a fresh 15-minute link for the same pending proposal revision through the existing web-review staging, only when the newest link has expired or no longer matches the draft (a still-working link is pointed to, never duplicated); "Cancel draft" cancels through the canonical decideGeneralProposalInTransaction; "Check status" re-reads the canonical proposal and receipt and reports Saved once (receipt title and detail), Not saved, or Still checking, never re-executing. A short "link expired" complaint about an open draft gets a fixed notice with New link and Cancel draft buttons; "I approved but the page said check status" gets "That save isn't confirmed yet. Don't approve it again." with a Check status button. Buttons are the existing saved reply choices on a deterministic run; taps only count when they come from that fixed reply, and the link, actor, Store, conversation, draft and choice are re-read under the channel locks. Local only; no provider, OTP, schema or deployment change.
noAssistantImpact: Channel rendering and deterministic recovery replies only. No tool, prompt, capability declaration or new write is added: the new link reuses prepareAssistantWhatsAppWebReview for the existing proposal reference, and cancel reuses the canonical proposal decision.

docs.note: No capability declaration, tool, rollout or permission change; recovery reuses existing web-review staging and the canonical proposal decision.

evidence.result: 6 pass, 40 expects: link message shape, recovery phrase matching, the New link / Cancel draft / Check status decision table, and notice parts that validate and carry the fixed reply choices.
4 pass, 8 expects: quoted link, unquoted latest link, fixed recovery reply versus model reply, and foreign-binding tokens.
3 pass: recovery words from an unlinked identity touch no persistence; existing reply-choice guards unchanged.

Not run: the transactional recovery turn (fresh link staging, canonical cancel, status re-read) has no database-backed test here; DB integration needs QA_ACCESS_ACCEPTANCE_DATABASE_HOST, which is not configured.
